narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to debunk a common misconception regarding food freshness and its link to digestive issues. The chef uses logical reasoning and professional kitchen expertise to explain that bacterial growth, rather than a lack of freshness or long cooking times, is the primary cause of stomach pain. He supports his argument with examples from Japanese aging techniques to provide a comprehensive educational message.
